value.rationale: For genomic-offset predictions, genetic-effect directions are typically unobserved. The exact architecture-to-architecture reliability distribution is a natural, scientifically motivated uncertainty-calibration quantity not determined by worst-case support bounds. Its different mean and median deficit rates identify a concrete rare-misalignment mechanism: high typical reliability can coexist with substantially worse ensemble average reliability. This informs interpretation of population-genomic predictive scores under a specified identifiable uncertainty model, even without a general empirical downstream claim.
